subject: Full-loop logistics: staggered virtual slots + debrief ownership
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie@talentpartner.com>
To: diego_fernandez, laura_bennett, marissa_cole, jonas_weber
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed virtual full-loop for Aisha Khan (resume attached)

Hi team —

Hope you’re well. I’m coordinating a virtual full interview loop for Aisha Khan (resume attached). She’s excited about the Platform/Inference role and available the week of May 25 and the morning of May 28 PST.

Proposed structure (1x 90-min window or two contiguous slots):
- 45 min engineering deep-dive (systems / perf / inference tradeoffs)
- 30 min system design / architecture (paired whiteboard)
- 30 min manager / culture conversation

We can compress into a 120-min contiguous block with small buffer, or split into two windows (90 + 30) if that reduces interviewer context switching. Candidate prefers morning (9am	6:30am PST or 10am	12pm PST).

Attached: Aisha_Khan_Resume.pdf

Can you confirm availability + whether you prefer contiguous or split windows? If contiguous, we recommend building a 15-min buffer at the midpoint for quick notes and a 30-min debrief after.

Thanks,
Sophie
Senior Recruiter, TalentPartner
On behalf of Redwood Inference Hiring Team

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie@talentpartner.com>
Cc: laura_bennett, marissa_cole, jonas_weber
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed virtual full-loop for Aisha Khan (resume attached)

Thanks Sophie  looping the core panel.

Quick thoughts from Ops: I prefer two contiguous slots (120 min) only when we can guarantee contiguous interviewer handover. For this role I think a staggered approach reduces context-switching for folks who have tight slates:

Option A (compact contiguous)
- 09:30	11:30 PST: Full loop compressed (Eng deep-dive 45 / System design 35 / Manager 30)
- 11:3012:00 PST: Team debrief (owners: volunteer?)

Option B (staggered windows)
- 09:300:40 PST: Eng deep-dive + short buffer
- 11:0011:40 PST: System design + manager conversation (allows different interviewers to join)
- 12:102:40 PST: 30-min debrief (concrete action: score + top-3 notes)

Key asks:
- One debrief owner to collect scores and send final notes to Sophie within 2 hours after the loop.
- Please confirm whether folks want Miro or Google Jamboard for the design portion (we have a whiteboard link template).

I attached a quick agenda template (full_loop_agenda_v2.xlsx) with timeboxes and handoff markers. I can take debrief owner if no objections.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Staff Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

I prefer Miro for design; it preserves the artifact for post-loop review.
